app.name: CV Builder
app.tagline: Free, multilingual and responsive resume generator
app.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all entered data?

hero.title: Build a standout resume that lands interviews
hero.subtitle: Craft a sleek, modern resume with instant real-time preview. Choose from professionally curated templates, fill your details and export to crisp high-resolution PDF.
hero.feature1Desc: Watch every keystroke update your A4 document in real-time.
hero.feature2Desc: Download directly in high quality or print with optimized margins for recruiters.
hero.feature3Desc: Your progress is saved securely in your browser so you never lose work.
hero.feature4Desc: Interface seamlessly switches between French, English, and Spanish.

templates.title: Choose your resume template
templates.subtitle: Battle-tested layouts designed to impress hiring managers and pass ATS scans.

modern.name: Modern
modern.description: Dynamic two-column sidebar layout with crisp typography and balanced visual hierarchy.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: Timeless single-column design with refined serif headings, ideal for corporate, finance, and legal roles.

creative.name: Creative
creative.description: Bold asymmetric header with vibrant accent color blocks, perfect for designers, marketers, and tech innovators.

minimalist.name: Minimalist
minimalist.description: Clean Swiss-inspired aesthetic with generous whitespace and typographic clarity.

executive.name: Executive
executive.description: Prestigious top-bar format with authoritative elegance for senior managers and consultants.

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.subtitle: Provide your contact coordinates so recruiters can easily get in touch.
personal.photoHint: JPG or PNG recommended. Max size 3 MB.

summary.subtitle: Highlight your core strengths, proven achievements, and career direction in 3-5 lines.
